app_release.title: OCYRA 2.0.0 Plugin Platform Release
text: The plugin-first runtime is now active for speech, translation, audit/accessibility, and format workflows.
Signed plugin catalogs, shared dependency installs, and plugin-host execution are now part of the active desktop runtime.
Enterprise and self-hosted catalog deployments can use the same signed catalog model as the public OCYRA catalog.
